calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Aegis Marrow (the Warden), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Aegis Marrow, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Aegis Marrow's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A stoic young knight with a lean, upright, square-shouldered build and a calm, unreadable face: fair skin, straight silver-grey brows, a firm jaw, steel-grey eyes that glow soft teal. Short silver-white hair swept back and tousled, one longer lock over the left temple. Teal-and-steel plate armour: a deep teal breastplate with polished steel ridges, a high steel gorget, teal pauldrons with raised steel rims, teal-and-steel vambraces and greaves, dark steel belt and joints, thin brass-gold trim. A dark teal undersuit shows between the plates. A short deep-teal cloak falls from the shoulders down the back, lined in pale steel, its hem torn. WEAPON: a towering TOWER SHIELD, about three-quarters of her standing height, with a flat teal face, a bright gold rim, a dark steel boss and one large gold eight-pointed star; its lower edge tapers to a point. Held upright in her LEFT hand: forearm strapped into a steel arm-guard, fist on a steel grip behind the boss, the face always turned toward the opponent. Her RIGHT hand is an empty steel gauntlet that joins on the shield's upper rim for heavy charges. Energy, bash trails and Art glow are TEAL-WHITE light with GOLD star sparks.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right behind the planted shield; a walk; a run with the shield carried low on the left arm; a jump
- top row end: a close-up of the shield face with its gold star and rim
- middle row 1: standing guard with the shield raised across the whole body; crouch guard; a short shield punch
- middle row 2: a diagonal shield chop; a low swing; the shield charge with its gold star glowing
- bottom row: the plunge with the shield point-down; a hit reaction with the shield braced; knocked down with the shield still strapped on
- bottom row end: the victory pose with the shield planted; the Bulwark barrier up in front of her
Include at least one pose showing the back of the shield with its steel straps and grip.
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.

  colours identical between frames; only the pose changes.

THIS SHEET: Stance, guard and footwork
  1. combat idle loop 1: fighting stance behind the planted tower shield, shield upright on the left arm with its point near the ground, knees bent, body square behind the shield's edge, chin down, gold star facing the opponent
  2. combat idle loop 2: the same stance breathing in, shoulders raised a little, the shield lifted a finger's width on its forearm, cloak drifting
  3. combat idle loop 3: the same stance at the top of the breath, the gold star catching a bright highlight
  4. combat idle loop 4: the same stance breathing out, the shield settling back onto its point, returning toward frame 1
  5. standing guard: the tower shield raised in front of the whole body, its top edge just above her eyes and its face square to the opponent, the body hidden behind the teal face and gold star, her eyes peeking over the rim, both knees bent, the right gauntlet braced on the shield's back edge
  6. crouch guard: low crouch on bent knees, the tower shield planted on its point in front of the body with its top edge at chest height, the body tucked behind it
  7. skid: braking hard from a run, the shield dragged low on its point throwing up sparks, front foot planted, body leaning back, cloak swinging forward
  8. landing: absorbing a landing from a jump, deep knee bend, the shield's point planted beside the front foot, the right gauntlet low for balance, cloak still settling
